description: Search verified x402 sellers by capability (a set compiled from Agenstry, Open 402 and pay.sh listings, with price, networks and evidence of a live 402 challenge or manifest). Free tier returns the top 5; full results are available as the paid /search endpoint (x402 or MPP) on the same host. Calls and paying wallets are null for now: demand figures (calls and paying wallets over 30 days) return after our on-chain measurement is live.

include_testnets.description: also list services that exist only on test networks (default false)

query.description: capability to look for, e.g. 'web search', 'llm inference'

name: search_x402_services
title: Search x402 services
